firm_data.firm_description: Hecht Partners is a litigation boutique focused on complex commercial disputes, high-stakes trials, and international arbitration. They represent individuals, start-ups, and small to mid-cap companies whose interests align with the rule of law, corporate accountability, and ESG principles.
notable_facts: Recently won a $20.75 million trial victory in the BNP case
The firm integrates deep experience in domestic class actions, public international law, and intellectual property, operating at the intersection of law, science, and technology.
Entrepreneurial culture and lean, technology-enabled infrastructure
technology_signals: Impact Team composed of lawyers, technologists, and scientists

email.subject: AI for Hecht Partners, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Your $20.75 million trial victory in the BNP case reflects the caliber of work Hecht Partners delivers on complex commercial disputes. That kind of high-stakes litigation demands precision, speed, and flawless execution across document review and case strategy.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Given your Impact Team approach with lawyers, technologists, and scientists working together, I think there's real alignment here. We'd love to show you how similar firms are competing with BigLaw on discovery and motion practice.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
